findings.reason: MI001 remains AMBIGUOUS and OPEN, needed_at prepare, originating at main:/missing_information/items/0. This page supports the Figure 3a panel–strain–MIC–regimen–response association through A39–A42, but A43 explicitly states that no matched measured PK exists for these efficacy regimens. DR020 is therefore UNRESOLVED. The wider mouse-panel mapping has not been assessed from other items. Escalate the dependent preparation decision; do not create matched regimen-level exposure-response records from this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported exposure inputs and their applicability to this efficacy regimen, complete dosing-event timing, and review of the remaining panel associations required by SC032. Retain MI001 unchanged until the responsible preparation review records its outcome.

findings.reason: A39 identifies P. aeruginosa FADDI-PA038. The observed PMB efficacy and susceptibility inputs are relevant supporting material, but they cannot establish K. pneumoniae PD targets under R07 and R14. Requirement links indicate partial input coverage, not eligibility for the requested K. pneumoniae analysis.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of this panel's supporting or benchmark role; eligible K. pneumoniae evidence for K. pneumoniae index ranking and target estimation.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs include strain identity, lung-burden units, pre-treatment and vehicle comparators, observation times, a PMB regimen and a stated MIC. MIC method, medium, standard, replicates and summary definition are NOT_FOUND. Inoculum, host strain and immune status, infection-to-treatment interval, exact dosing-event times and an explicit treatment-duration definition are NOT_FOUND. Only one PMB schedule is supplied; variation in dosing frequency or interval is not established. DR024 remains UNRESOLVED for response-linked use.
findings.needed_material: If this organism's response-linked analysis is authorized, obtain source-supported experimental and MIC methods, treatment timing, relevant exposure inputs and design evidence addressing dose and interval variation. Keep index ranking unresolved pending downstream review.

findings.reason: No body values are supplied at F45 or F47; F46 contains 9.4. The missing positions must remain missing, with reasons NOT_FOUND. No BLQ flags or assay limits are stated. findings.needed_material: Preserve the supplied missing positions and group-scoped column labels. Confirm missingness reasons and any original animal identifiers only from authorized source evidence; do not invent values or identities.
